constructs.reason: One finite Instruction has an unambiguous typed outcome distribution.
Per-instruction marginals lose correlation and a stable joint history model is not part of v2.1.
A checked signed 64-bit scalar is a finite canonical outcome.
Text has canonical RFC-0003 serialization and finite equality.
Boolean Values form a finite two-element outcome domain.
Finite nested Values are canonical outcomes while collection and byte limits hold.
Finite RollSet values can be represented by their typed source values and deterministic annotations.
A validated immutable host Value is a constant in the analysis plan.
RFC-0001 variables contain Values, not caller-defined probability distributions or lazy sources.
Positive finite numeric sides define a uniform rational distribution.
A checked finite inclusive integer range defines a uniform rational distribution.
RFC-0001 uniform, integer, and percentage weights normalize to exact integers.
Sequential draws without replacement are finite but ordered support grows factorially.
Probability-proportional-to-remaining-weight draws are exact but ordered support can grow factorially.
A pure validator partitions a finite input distribution without generating randomness.
Finite scalar convolution is exact when every reachable checked operation succeeds.
Division is exact only when every reachable divisor is non-zero and checked i64 division succeeds.
Exponentiation requires finite non-negative exponents and proof that every checked i64 result succeeds.
Keep and drop are deterministic finite transformations of a RollSet.
Filter, sort, and count deterministically transform each finite outcome.
Occurrences deterministically projects one finite collection outcome.
Postfix unique is deterministic deduplication and does not refill the source.
Paint, split, and fixed-width group are deterministic transformations under collection/output limits.
One replacement draw is finite but multiplies the source state space.
Explode, keep-and-explode, reroll-until, and reroll-and-add have unbounded support or budget-dependent failure probability.
Merge introduces another exact expression and a Cartesian state product.
Instruction-history dependence requires a joint Program state model excluded from v2.1.
A literal finite repeat count over an exact body has a bounded but potentially exponential state product.
An exact predicate and exact reachable branches can be combined while branch/state limits hold.
Backward jump is reserved by RFC-0001 and has no bounded execution semantics.
CLI commands do not produce reproducible language Values.
A trailing comment is metadata and does not change the outcome distribution.
